content:
A Small Achievement, A Big Motivation! ⚖️✨

Happy to share that I secured 10th Rank in Provocatio Legis 2.0 – National Level Quiz Competition on Contract Law, organised by The Jus Anima.

Participating in a national-level competition was a great opportunity to test my knowledge of Contract Law and learn along the way. 📚⚖️

Securing a place among the Top 10 performers has motivated me to keep learning, participating and improving my legal skills.

Grateful for the experience and looking forward to many more such opportunities! 🌱
